acceptanceCriteria: click-submit step that triggers a create request and only asserts a dialog closed is reported
the same step with a response wait started before the click and a status assertion after is not reported
read-only GET requests are not reported
an in-file example of the correct pattern is cited when present; abstain when the request cannot be resolved
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1194. Flag a browser test step where a user action triggers a first-party POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE (from the run's network record, or statically from the action plus the awaited route) and no assertion in the same step binds that request's response (status or body). Point to an in-file example of the response-wait-before-click pattern when one exists. GET requests are not reported.
title: GH #1194: WRITE-RESPONSE-UNASSERTED - UI step triggers a write request but asserts only UI side effects
